model.name: BUG11: ⚠REGRESSION — URL action buttons (Open in preview / Open in new tab) do nothing on click.
model.description: REGRESSION (PRIORITY): link.url leaf renders the URL-action buttons (Open in preview / Open in new tab per R19.77) BUT clicking them does NOTHING. These buttons WORKED pre-drawer-consolidation. Broke in v0.6.10-22 drawer refactor — the click handlers were not re-wired after the drawer consolidation (R20.6g). The buttons render but have no attached event listeners. FIX: re-wire the Open-in-preview (load URL in sandboxed iframe) and Open-in-new-tab (window.open target=_blank) handlers in the consolidated drawer path.
model.tronQuote: > TRON (device evidence IMG_4022): URL action buttons render but clicking does NOTHING (regression from drawer consolidation).
model.crossRefNote: R19.77 (URL two-button preview) defined the working behavior. R20.6g (drawer consolidation) broke the handler wiring. BUG11 = buttons render but handlers missing after refactor.
